meta.title: Home
meta.description: PT Sarana Piranti Energi (SPE) - a trusted partner for Indonesia's Oil & Gas industry, engaged in trading and management of Condensate, LPG, and CNG.

hero.headline: Trusted Partner for Indonesia's Oil & Gas Industry
hero.tagline: PT Sarana Piranti Energi is engaged in the trading, storage, and management of Condensate, LPG, and CNG.

aboutSnippet.heading: About Us
aboutSnippet.text: Founded in early 2023, PT Sarana Piranti Energi (SPE) combines the technology and networking expertise of PT Step Point Indonesia with the deep experience of gas-industry practitioners in engineering, sales, and investment. We now participate directly in the sales, production, and development of Indonesia's oil and gas sector.

visionMission.heading: Vision & Mission
visionMission.visionText: To become the best company in the Oil & Gas field and its management.
visionMission.missionText: To continuously improve service and high productivity in all activities.

items.title: Condensate
items.description: High-value hydrocarbon liquid from natural gas production - a key raw material for petrochemicals, fuel, and industrial solvents.

items.title: LPG
items.description: Liquefied Petroleum Gas: Butane & Propane produced through an LPG splitter - clean energy for households and industry (in development).

items.title: CNG
items.description: Compressed Natural Gas: an environmentally friendly fuel alternative - CNG processing facilities are planned for future development.

processTeaser.heading: Our Oil & Gas Value Chain
processTeaser.body: From gas exploration to the end consumer - SPE is present at every stage of the oil and gas industry value chain.

partners.heading: Business Partners
partners.disclaimer: Relationships shown are trading (buy/sell) relationships, not joint ventures or formal endorsements.
